basis: all four gates green with machine checkers; closure is CONDITIONAL because one G0 amendment was used (schedule-name repair) and a newly measured trace-mode defect limits the qualified envelope — radioactive initial composition under auto/trace mode is treated as an undepleted constant source and is not qualified; solver and population components are empirically estimated, not rigorously bounded; no physical-accuracy or convergence claim follows
g0_amendments: criteria_cases initially named the 1 d schedule 'pulse_1d'; the P27 frozen study names it 'cont_1d'. Renamed to the real case ids before any P29 run.

analytic_controls.chain_mo99_tc99m: inferred Mo-99->Tc-99m branch 0.8789 at 3600 s hold; long-hold (86400 s) daughter predicted within tolerance
analytic_controls.impulse_decay_mn56: rel err 9.4e-15 vs ENDF/B-VIII.0 t12 9284.04 s (coupled mode, feed decays correctly)
analytic_controls.near_zero: zero-flux case reports total activity exactly 0.0
analytic_controls.stiff_1y: Fe FNS 5 min + 1 y cooling: declared-vs-reference activity rel diff 4e-13; reference populates 684 states vs declared 65

conformance.envelope_violating_criterion: unqualified response refused at validation naming family_not_qualified
conformance.resource_limit_exhaustion: unattainable bound with resource_limit_runs 0 recorded unmet with zero escalations
conformance.unproducible_response: criterion at a time the case never emits recorded unestablished, not a silent pass

criteria_population.inventory_tail_note: declared default pruning drops nuclides present in the reference solve (rel diff 1.0 on inventory_per_nuclide); criteria satisfied only after escalating to prune none

discovered_limitation.description: under mode auto/trace the initial composition is a constant reservoir: a radioactive feed nuclide (e.g. Mn-56) produces daughters at rate lambda*N without depleting; over a 86400 s hold the daughter is overproduced ~6.45x and mass is not conserved
discovered_limitation.evidence: impulse_decay_mn56 under mode auto reported undepleted activity and Fe-56 6.45e15 atoms/g from a 1e15 feed; mode coupled reproduces the analytic value at 9.4e-15
discovered_limitation.qualified_envelope: criteria and controls are qualified under the P29 reference path (coupled); radioactive initial composition under auto/trace is unqualified and recorded here

error_components.population_pruning_and_mode: empirically_estimated (declared vs no-prune/coupled variant), reaches 1.0 on inventory tail
error_components.processing_collapse: bounded at the P25c/P28 measured tolerance 1e-6; not a rigorous bound
error_components.solver_time_integration: empirically_estimated (CRAM-16 vs CRAM-48 variant), max observed ~1e-12 on scalar responses

notes: no release, superiority, demand, or regulatory claim follows; the criteria qualify computational error only within the demonstrated envelope

exclusions: radioactive initial composition under auto/trace mode (undepleted-reservoir defect, recorded)
any total physical-accuracy or convergence claim
nuclear-data and model discrepancy — separate error class, not covered by these criteria
qualified_regime.mechanism: ACT-REFINE-01 per-(response,time) criteria on the five qualified responses
qualified_regime.population: 8-case P27 smoke population, Fe and Fe+100wppm-Co over FNS and IRDFF spectra
